reason: The pressure patch kit is the apparent way to seal the punctured habitat wall before refilling it.
expectation: The kit should seal the damaged wall.

alternatives.reason: Stabilizing the lander also matters before retrieving supplies.

effect: The habitat wall is sealed; it still needs breathing gas.
reaction: The backing plate makes the repair feel practical.
reason: The gas supply is the obvious next step toward refilling the sealed habitat.
expectation: The supply should refill the sealed habitat.

alternatives.reason: The lander also needs stabilizing before retrieving supplies.

effect: The habitat is breathable, and the next goal is to make the lander safe to board.
reaction: The regulator and gauge make the refill understandable.
reason: The shipping braces are the most obvious means of stabilizing the damaged landing support.
expectation: The braces should help stabilize the lander.

effect: The braces needed cutting into usable steel before they could support the lander.
reaction: The preparation makes sense, though I had expected the braces to fit directly.
reason: The steel lengths and sheet look suitable for reinforcing the unstable landing support.
expectation: The steel should help stabilize the lander, perhaps using the tool kit.

effect: The steel became a load-spreading crib, stabilizing the lander and completing the chapter's goals.
reaction: The wide base and inspection details made the repair satisfying and physically plausible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the crib was most worthwhile: it resolved the immediate danger and explained how the support carries the load.

leastWorthwhile.text: Refilling the habitat was straightforward and predictable, though the regulator and gauge gave it useful physical context.

surprise.text: The shipping braces first had to be cut into usable steel rather than applied directly to the support.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the initially hidden preparation step was sensible once the result explained it.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repair details and the prospect of exploring the expedition make me curious about what comes next.
